message.content: Based on the conversations provided, WolfgangSchulz remembers several places in Europe as stunning. He mentions the fjords in Norway as breathtaking, describing them as "just can't beat those views." Additionally, WolfgangSchulz expresses enthusiasm for Prague, noting that "the architecture is just magical, especially at night" and appreciating the "vibe of the old town." Furthermore, he talks fondly of the lavender fields in Provence, describing them as "like a sea of purple" and highlighting the "beauty of the water against the cliffs" in Amalfi Coast. These places stand out as particularly memorable for WolfgangSchulz during his travels across Europe.
